Content: Product-library factor bank for the new CAP catalog. One factor per value-card slot (cost, carbon, timing, efficiency). Values, calculation methods, evidence URLs, and cases are taken only from Consolidate.xlsx.
Not a copy of the old UCF/IPF Low–Base–High bank. Not a site-quantity (L3) calculator. Not extra research beyond Consolidate.

Section: Why it is not a wide-table dump
Content: Consolidate is one fat row per initiative. This workbook normalises that row into initiatives, four factor banks, evidence, factor↔evidence map, initiative↔factor map, calculation methods, cases, case sources, coverage, and a gap register — the same shape as the previous factor-bank pack.
INIT-#### — same sequence as catalog import / Admin.
CCF-#### cost, CPF-#### carbon, CTF-#### timing, CEF-#### efficiency.
CEVID-#### — unique URL+locator pairs, same sequence as catalog import.
CASE-#### — same sequence as catalog import.
Value_Low / Value_Base / Value_High are parsed from the published display string only. A range fills Low and High. A single number fills Base. No midpoint is invented. Unparseable text stays blank.
Empty published figures stay empty. Missing methods and missing evidence are listed in Factor Gap Register, not filled.
display_only for every row. L3 executable rules are out of scope for this bank.
